responses.description: Returned when the long running delete operation has failed, and has reached a terminal state.

This is a long running operation. The operation returns a 202 if the validation is complete. The response includes an Azure-AsyncOperation header that contains a status URL. Clients are expected to poll the status URL for the status of the operation. The status URL returns 204 No Content when the deletion is complete.
Returned when the long running delete operation has finished, or the private endpoint does not exist.
